title: Collector: drop blank OFFER candidates (TD-12), open /healthz + token on /metrics only; FEP-0006 questions 2-4 closed
notes: TrustProcessor runs drop_blank_candidates after the commit gate: blank texts leave shown; an OFFER / OFFER_WORDS with none left becomes ABSTAIN with shown = [] (an OFFER without shown would read as a TD-10 privacy log); ASK stays ASK. Metrics blank_candidates_dropped, blank_offers_abstained. /healthz open (status only), bearer token protects /metrics only; non-localhost bind without token still a config error unless allow_unauthenticated. Automatic gate kept. FEP-0006 Decisions (second round) closes questions 2-4. Tests in tests/test_collector.py.
